title: Epistemology: knowledge with two faces
subtitle: Policy tree · four cards
intro: Every piece of knowledge carries a second face. Open it, then decide which face enters the public archive.
closing: Four policies are nailed to the wall. Knowledge did not become one face; your choices just pressed it to one side.
doneLabel: Nail the policies to the wall

cards.title: First aid and where to get help

faces.text: Let people know where to go for help.
Screenshotted as shock material, turned into a new wound.

policies.label: Publish directly
policies.line: Send it out. Someone gets saved; someone learns to hurt people.

policies.label: Publish with context
policies.line: Add a paragraph. It blocks some of it, but not reposts.

policies.label: Withhold the details
policies.line: Hide it. The people who need it may never find it.
